title: Second conditional
note: Unreal or unlikely present: If I had more time, I would learn Italian. Czech kdybych + conditional produces *If I would have more time word for word - that is the whole target error. a2_first_conditional is the real-possibility one; third and mixed stay B2. If I were you is taught as a fixed phrase for advice. First draft 2026-09-02, rough - thicken after smoke.

cards.title: Second conditional
points: The past form does not mean the past. It means: this is not true now.

examples.en: **If** I had more time, I **would** learn Italian.
examples.cz: Kdybych měl víc času, učil bych se italsky.

examples.en: What **would** you do if you won?

cards.title: would never goes in the if half
cards.title_cz: would nikdy nepatří do části s if
points: Czech puts the conditional in both halves. English puts it in one.

cards.title: first or second?
points: Real chance → the first kind. Imaginary → this one.

rows: it is not going to, but imagine

cards.title: If I were you
points: **were** is used for every person in this phrase. *If I was you* is not the set form.

rows: **If I** were you, I'd take the job.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: One half gets **would**. The **if** half gets the past form.

rows: ~~If I would have more time, I would learn Italian.~~
**If** I **had** more time, I would learn Italian.
~~If I will win, I would buy a house.~~
~~If I was you, I'd take the job.~~
**If I** were you, I'd take the job.
~~I would to go if I had time.~~
I **would** go if I had time.

items.en: If I had more time, I would learn Italian.
items.cz: Kdybych měl víc času, učil bych se italsky.
items.gap: If I ____ more time, I would learn Italian. (have)
accepts: If I had more time, I would learn Italian.
items.wrong: If I would have more time, I would learn Italian.
items.explanation: The **if** half takes the past form **had**. would belongs in the other half.
items.explanation_cz: Část s **if** má minulý tvar **had**. would patří do druhé části.

items.en: What would you do if you won the lottery?
items.cz: Co bys dělal, kdybys vyhrál v loterii?
items.gap: What ____ you do if you won the lottery? (will / would)
accepts: What would you do if you won the lottery?
items.explanation: The result half takes **would** + the plain verb do.
items.explanation_cz: Výsledková část má **would** + základní tvar do.

items.en: If I were you, I'd take the job.
items.cz: Být tebou, vzal bych tu práci.
items.gap: If I ____ you, I'd take the job. (be)
accepts: If I were you, I'd take the job.
If I were you, I would take the job.
items.wrong: If I was you, I'd take the job.
items.explanation: **If I were you** is the fixed phrase for advice.
items.explanation_cz: **If I were you** je ustálená fráze pro radu.

items.en: If he came earlier, we would have more time.
items.cz: Kdyby přišel dřív, měli bychom víc času.
items.gap: If he ____ earlier, we would have more time. (come)
accepts: If he came earlier, we would have more time.
items.wrong: If he would come earlier, we would have more time.
items.explanation: Past form **came** in the if half, not would come.
items.explanation_cz: Minulý tvar **came** v části s if, ne would come.

items.en: I would buy a bigger flat if I had the money.
items.cz: Koupil bych si větší byt, kdybych měl peníze.
items.gap: I ____ a bigger flat if I had the money. (buy)
accepts: I would buy a bigger flat if I had the money.
items.explanation: **would** + the plain verb **buy**, with no to.

items.en: If I lived in London, I would go to the theatre every week.
items.cz: Kdybych bydlel v Londýně, chodil bych každý týden do divadla.
items.gap: If I ____ in London, I would go to the theatre. (live)
accepts: If I lived in London, I would go to the theatre every week.
items.explanation: **lived** — the past form marks it as not true now.
items.explanation_cz: **lived** — minulý tvar značí, že to teď neplatí.

items.en: She would be happier if she changed jobs.
items.cz: Byla by šťastnější, kdyby změnila práci.
items.gap: She ____ happier if she changed jobs. (be)
accepts: She would be happier if she changed jobs.

items.en: If it rained, we would stay at home.
items.gap: If it ____, we would stay at home. (rain)
accepts: If it rained, we would stay at home.
items.wrong: If it will rain, we would stay at home.
items.explanation: Imagining, not predicting, so **rained** and would stay.
items.explanation_cz: Představa, ne předpověď, takže **rained** a would stay.

items.en: What would you say if she asked you?
items.cz: Co bys řekl, kdyby se tě zeptala?
items.gap: What would you say if she ____ you? (ask)
accepts: What would you say if she asked you?
items.explanation: The **if** half stays in the past form: asked.
items.explanation_cz: Část s **if** zůstává v minulém tvaru: asked.

items.en: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
items.cz: Kdybych znal odpověď, řekl bych ti.
items.gap: If I ____ the answer, I would tell you. (know)
accepts: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
items.wrong: If I would know the answer, I would tell you.
items.explanation: **knew** in the if half. The point is that I do not know it.
items.explanation_cz: **knew** v části s if. Jde o to, že ji neznám.
